caption: A plastic pen rubbed on a wool sleeve is held over pepper grains scattered on a plate, and the grains jump onto the pen.

sa.check: A plastic pen is rubbed on a wool sleeve.
Pepper grains are scattered on a plate.
The pen is held over the grains.
The grains are scattered loose on the plate, not in a pile.
The rub comes first, then the hold, then the jump.

pc.expect: The grains lie still until the pen is close above them, then leap up to it; grains far from the pen stay put and the leaping stops when the pen is taken away.
pc.fail: Grains leap before the pen is brought near; or grains across the plate slide toward the pen; or the whole plate of grains stirs at once; or grains keep leaping after the pen is well away.

pc.expect: The grains that lift cling to the pen's underside and sides; any that let go fall back to the plate.
pc.fail: Grains hover in the air between plate and pen without touching either; or a grain that lets go drifts upward or sideways; or grains rise past the pen and continue up; or the plate lifts toward the pen.

pc.expect: Each grain moves straight up from the plate to the pen and stops on it.
pc.fail: Grains fly past the pen and off; or circle the pen in the air; or bounce off and back several times; or grains move away from the pen.

pc.expect: The pen is a rigid stick; the grains are separate hard specks that lift individually.
pc.fail: The pen bends toward the plate; or the grains lift as one lump; or grains smear into a paste; or the plate bends.

pc.expect: One pen and one plate; the grains on the pen came from the plate; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the plate.
pc.fail: Grains multiply on the pen; or grains vanish in mid-air; or the pen passes into the plate; or a second pen appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pen's colour, the plate and the sleeve stay the same.
pc.fail: The pen changes colour or shape; or the plate changes pattern; or the sleeve changes colour.

note: Who holds the pen is not judged.
